snippet.title: PlayStation - Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu '95 Kaimakuban (1995)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu '95 Kaimakuban is a Sports game, developed by Diamond Head and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 1995.
